messages:
Devon: Quick async check for the train — cut window at 20:00 UTC. Current queue: 6 cherry-picks (3 critical). Anyone with blockers?

Maya: Did the final perf run. Canary perf looks green overall but p50 jumped ~12ms for seq=1024 on model v2.0. Investigating, might be noisy.

Liam: Wrapping the backport for #4821 (retry fix). Will push by 18:30 UTC. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4892

Sam: Seeing an intermittent CI flake in staging e2e — latency test timeout. Rerunning now. If it flakes again, can we skip it for the cut?

Devon: @Maya can you paste the failing metric and a quick reproduction? If it's just p50 and within our acceptance band we can accept.

Maya: Repro steps and logs below:
```
kubectl logs -n canary model-serve-2 | grep p50
# run load test
./bench --seq 1024 --qps 50 --model v2.0
```
p50 baseline: 28ms -> canary: 40ms (delta +12ms). Also seeing a small mem bump (~200MB).

Liam: FYI the backport needs a configmap reload after merge; I'll coordinate with ops once merged.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout at 19:00 UTC. Alerting hooks: #pager and @oncall.

Sam: CI rerun in progress... if it fails again I'll mark the PR with `ci:skip-cut` and we can patch post-cut. Prefer not to block release for flakes.

Devon: Plan for cut: accept the 3 critical cherries (4830, 4892, 4911), postpone 2 noncritical (4877, 4903), and hold 1 (4855) until rollback concern is resolved. @Liam confirm backport landed by 18:30. @Maya post perf delta + dashboard link by 18:45.

Maya: Will post dashboard. Also digging into the mem bump, could be transient from an extra shard during canary.

Liam: Backport merged at 18:22 UTC, PR 4892. Triggering configmap reload and canary restart.

ops-bot: Canary started: deploy/serve-canary-1946205600. Health: green. Deploy URL: https://deploys.internal/redwood/serve-canary/1946205600

Sam: CI rerun passed on attempt #2 — marking that test flaky. :thumbsup:

Devon: Good catch. If anyone sees latency > +25ms during ramp at 19:10 UTC post a screenshot and tag @Devon @Maya. Otherwise proceed with the cut.

Maya: :thumbsup: dashboard link: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/perf/serve-canary/1946205600 — will post a short note when checks finish.

Liam: I'll be on standby for rollback runbook steps. Runbook pinned in #eng-releases and internal runbook doc.

Devon: Thanks all — updating the release notes and cut plan. No further replies needed unless a blocker appears.
